selection_rule: Only the primary run selects zcp_selected; supporting runs are provenance-only and are neither averaged nor cherry-picked.
validation: Primary architecture equals the predeclared seed-20260731 winner.
All three canonical architecture IDs are unique.
Supporting winners appear only as supporting_robustness_only provenance.
Resource matching uses Cream AutoFormer official complexity ops, not generic FLOPs.
No test metric participates in selection.
next_gate: Each frozen candidate must pass configured full-batch memory and checkpoint-resume smoke before dual one-percent ImageNet acceptance starts.
